title: Guild Wars Survivors
author: ExcellentBarber63
selftext:
You may have seen some of the Survivors-style fan games popping up lately, including the Pokemon Survivors and Azeroth Survivors. I wanted to give Guild Wars 1 the same treatment, so I’ve been building **Guild Wars Survivors**.

It’s a free browser game with solo play and multiplayer co-op. Pick a profession, combine skills and items, and fight through waves of enemies. No account, registration, or download required.

**Play here:** [https://guildwars-survivors.app/](https://guildwars-survivors.app/)

**How I built it**

I’ve been using ChatGPT/Codex for coding, debugging, and iteration, with a local Guild Wars 1 installation as the source for the game assets.

One of the more interesting parts was getting those assets into the browser. I had to provide the **Gw.dat** archive from my installation, and we had to actually download and process the asset files. Luckily for this game there were other tools out there that already knew how to dissect the asset pack. Codex was able to identify these tools and run them via command line, then convert these assets in a usable manner.

My workflow has been a repeated loop of describing a feature, having Codex implement it, playing the result, and bringing back specific problems or adjustments. That includes everything from profession balance and skill behavior to multiplayer issues and loading performance.

The biggest takeaway has been that generating a working feature and making it feel good are separate steps. Playtesting keeps revealing things that need another pass, especially when skills, items, enemy scaling, and multiplayer all interact.

I’d love feedback on the game, and I’m happy to discuss the build process. If you try it, let me know which profession you picked and how your run went!

This was a crazy process. It makes me feel like you can peel apart any game and make it into something new.

comments.author: MiamiStarz
comments.body: Even if it is non monetized fan project it easily can be DMCA’ed by owners, sadly. good thing it is NCSoft and usually they don’t care. I made similar game for another unpopular old MMO and got DMCA notice within a week lol

replies.author: ExcellentBarber63
replies.body: That is entirely true. We'll see what happens. I'm very seriously wondering how the Pokemon Survivors and Azeroth Survivors haven't been taken down yet as well.
